excerpt: EG 22 (BPI Cp 3) is a registered cowpea variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1992. It takes about 45 days from sowing to the first harvest, with 7.31 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about EG 22 (BPI Cp 3) cowpea
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

EG 22 (BPI Cp 3) cowpea takes about 45 days from sowing to the first harvest. That is 8.3 days faster than the average of the 13 cowpea varieties with a day count, 53.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.31 t/ha beats the average of its group, 5.44. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit cowpea fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its pods grew about 20.79 cm long. A hundred seeds weigh about 13.32 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed coat is maroon.
Where and when to plant EG 22 (BPI Cp 3) cowpea

Cowpea fits the dry season after rice, on the moisture the paddy keeps. Pick by use: green pods for vegetables, or dry seed. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 45 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 7.31 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of EG 22 (BPI Cp 3)?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
